free_tier.stated: 'There is no limit on uploading storage (total) for a channel.' Per-file cap 400 MB, from a help page last updated 7 years ago ('Updated: 7 years ago'). The 400 MB figure is stale and should be treated as unverified.

per_object_cap.notes: the maximum file size is 400M, from a help article labelled Updated:7 years ago

retention.notes: No retention period is stated in the publisher's help articles; a published channel page carries no retention clause.

egress.terms: No egress charge appears in the first-party creator help articles; the publisher presents itself as a free podcast app.

tooling: Creator Studio web dashboard only; no API. Castbox is primarily a player, so its hosting is a sideline.
chaining: Unlimited channels x unlimited episodes, if the 'no limit on total storage' line still holds. Multiple accounts are email-only.
limits_note: 400 MB per file (2019-era doc); accepted WAV/MP3/MP4/AAC/M4A. No retention or bandwidth figure published anywhere.
reliability_note: Unverifiable. The hosting doc carries no date beyond 'Page updated' and the file-type doc says 'Updated: 7 years ago'.
